content: Řḥukm issaggʷaden n wawař n SIDI x temmurt n Ḥadrax, řḥukm nni yarsan x Dimacq.
“Maɣar SIDI iḥeṭṭa x bnadem u x marra tiqebbař n Israil,
uřa x Ḥamat i-tt-dd-iřesqen, x Ṣur d Ṣidun, waxxa nitenti d timiɣisin aṭṭas.
Tebna Ṣur ijj n lbaraj i yixef nnes u teyru nnuqart am tɛejjajt d wureɣ iqquren am ubeǧaɛ n imesraq.
Xzar, Sidi inu ad tt iṭṭef, ad iwwet lbaraj nnes ɣar řebḥar, uca ad tt tecc tmessi.”

“Ackelun ad tt tẓar, ad tedweř teggʷed, ammu uřa d Ɣazza, ad tarjij aṭṭas, uřa d Ɛaqrun, maɣar ad ifceř uraji nnes. Ad ittwateḥḥa ujeǧid zi Ɣazza u di tandint n Acqalun war dayes tzeddeɣ ɛad uřa d ijjen.
Mmis n řeḥram ad izdeɣ di Acdud u Necc ad teḥḥiɣ nnfaxet n Ifilisṭiniyyen.
Necc ad ksiɣ idammen zeg uqemmum nnes uřa d nnɛawat zi jar tiɣmas nnes u ammu i ɣa iqqim uřa d netta i AREBBI nneɣ. Netta ad yiři am yijj n wemɣar di Yahuda u Ɛaqrun am yijj n Uyabusi.
Necc ad ggeɣ řmargeḥ inu deg wenneḍ n Taddart inu, ḍidd n wenni i ɣa iẓwan u ḍidd n wenni dd ɣa idewřen, ḥima wenni iḥeṣṣaren war xas iɛeddu ca ɛad, maɣar řexxu ẓřiɣ t s tiṭṭawin inu.”
Ajeǧid i dd ɣa yasen n Siḥyun

“Farḥ, a yeǧis n Ṣihyun, sřiwřew, a yeǧis n Urcalim! Xzar, Ajeǧid nnem yusa-dd ɣarem, Netta d amsegged u aqa yarḍ arruḍ n usenjem, Netta d amwaḍeɛ, inya x ijj n weɣyuř, x ijj n wezɛuq, asnus n ict n teɣyuč.

Necc ad qḍiɣ ikarruten n umenɣi zi Ifrayim uřa d iysan zi Urcalim. Ad ittwaqřeɛ uřa d řqews n umenɣi. Netta ad ibarreḥ s řehna i regnus u ṣṣulṭa nnes ad tiři zi řebḥar ař řebḥar, zeg iɣzar n Lfuraṭ ař ineggura n temmurt.”
“Wah uřa d cem, a yeǧis n Ṣihyun, zi ssibbet n idammen n Řɛahd nnem fekkeɣ-dd imeḥbas nnem zeg wanu yuẓɣen i war di ǧin waman.
Ɛeqbem ɣar lburj nwem, kenniw imeḥbas inni ɣar iǧa řayas. Uřa d ass-a Necc ttbarrḥeɣ: Aqa Necc ad ɣarem dd-arreɣ tnayen n tseqqar,
maɣar Necc ad meḥḍeɣ Yahuda am ijj n řqews u ad ggeɣ Ifrayim x řqews. Necc ad ssekkareɣ iḥenjiren nnem, a Ṣihyun, ḍidd i iḥenjiren nnec, a Yawan, u Necc ad cek arreɣ am ssif n ijj n bu-teɣruḍt.”
“SIDI ad iban sennej nsen u fřitcat nnes ad iřint ttwessgent am wassam u Sidi inu, SIDI,ْ ad isuḍ deg uyicc n icarri, ad yuyur ak-d tḥaryaḍin n usemmiḍ n ljanub.
SIDI n řɛeskarat ad ten issduriy. Nitni ad ccen, ad ddzen iẓra n iǧiy uca ad swen, ad ggen ddriz am ɣar binu u ad dewřen ccuren am ṭṭawya n urucci, am tɣemmar n uɛalṭar.
SIDI, AREBBI nwem ad ten issenjem deg wass nni am wuǧi n řgens nnes, maɣar nitni amecnaw iẓra iɣřan x ijj n ttaj igellden ittissiqen x temmurt nnes.
Maɣar mechař imɣar ad yiři řxar nnes u mechař imɣar ad yiři waẓři nnes! Imendi ad isseɣmi iḥudriyyen uřa binu n jdid tiɛzariyyin.”

footnotes.text: Yawan- ixs ad yini Lyunan n zic.
